title: Two Is Enough: Binary Classification Priors Suffice for Multi-Class In-Context Tabular Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.27569v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) pretrain a transformer on large-scale synthetic priors so that a single forward pass yields zero-shot tabular prediction. TabICLv2 samples the class count of its classification prior during pretraining, and the prevailing configuration caps it at ten. We report a counter-intuitive result: setting this cap directly to two---making every pretrained classification task binary---still yields weights that perform zero-shot K-way classification 2. On the 38 TabArena classification datasets (200 bootstrap rounds, anchored at default RF = 1000), the binary two-stage recipe reaches 1590.1 Elo, above the official default at 1568.0 (+22.1), above TabPFN-v2.6 (1577.1) and RealTabPFN-v2.5 (1521.6). A production-scale validation on 60 real-world credit-scoring institutions independently confirms the direction: the same checkpoint improves test AUC on 44 of 60 institutions (paired Wilcoxon p = 0.0007 for AUC, p = 0.0002

translated_title: 二分类足矣：二元分类先验即可胜任多类别上下文表格预测
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型（TFM）通过在大规模合成先验数据上预训练Transformer，使得单次前向传播即可实现零样本表格预测。TabICLv2在预训练期间对其分类先验的类别数量进行采样，而主流配置将该类别数上限设为10。我们报告了一个反直觉的结果：将该上限直接设为2——即让每个预训练分类任务都成为二分类任务——所得到的模型权重依然能够执行零样本K路分类。在38个TabArena分类数据集上（200轮bootstrap重采样，以默认RF=1000为基准），这种二元两阶段方案达到了1590.1的Elo评分，高于官方默认配置的1568.0（+22.1），也高于TabPFN-v2.6（1577.1）和RealTabPFN-v2.5（1521.6）。在60家真实信用评分机构上开展的生产规模验证独立证实了这一结论：同一个模型检查点在60家机构中的44家上提升了测试AUC（AUC的配对Wilcoxon检验 p = 0.0007，p = 0.0002
tldr: 该论文发现表格基础模型在预训练时仅需使用二分类先验任务（类别数上限设为2），即可实现优于传统十分类上限配置的零样本多分类预测性能，并在公开基准和真实信用评分场景中得到验证。
en_tdlr: Tabular foundation models pretrain with binary-only classification priors can achieve zero-shot multi-class prediction that outperforms the standard ten-class cap, validated on public benchmarks and real-world credit-scoring institutions.
